messages:
oliver: Quick heads-up: ops scheduled unpin runtime 5.0 -> 5.1 next Tue 01:00 UTC. QA surfaced a precision regression in eu-west embeddings. Tagging @maya.

deploy-bot: Proposed unpin: runtime-5.0->5.1. Window: 2026-06-02T01:00Z. To place a hold: `/deploybot hold unpin 1776543211 reason:"eu-embed-drift" approvers:@maya`

maya: Hold. Do not unpin EU. I'm seeing embedding normalization drift on long-document inputs in eu-west1. Staging reproducer attached to Jira EMB-2207.

infra-ops: We can soft-pin eu-west to 5.0 for 48h and still proceed elsewhere. Command to pin region: `/deploybot pin runtime runtime-5.0 scope:region=eu-west duration:48h reason:"precision-regress" approvers:@maya`

oliver: Please do that. Also prepare fallback pool for affected customers. We want minimal customer impact.

maya: Pin placed and global hold created. Hold expires in 24h.

qa-bot: Canary summary (eu-west staging): baseline vs candidate
 - short docs: 100/100 match
 - long docs (>1500 tokens): 6/60 mismatches, avg cosine delta=0.09 (threshold 0.03)

infra-ops: Noted. I'll coordinate the fallback routing tag `runtime_override=5.0` and spin up pinned pool.

oliver: Plan B if hotfix misses window: (1) unpin non-EU regions on schedule, (2) leave eu-west pinned and route VIPs, (3) ship customer note + postmortem.

maya: ETA for a precision tweak patch: ~10h. If tests show avg delta <0.03 we'll lift the hold early.

deploy-bot: Hold placed by maya on unpin 1776543211. Expires in 24h. Reason: eu-embed-drift. Approvers: maya, oliver.

oliver: Thanks team. Keeping decisions here. I'll publish a short release note draft after we decide. :thumbsup:
